thread:
jessie: FYI ran a stress repro on the on-prem keystore proxy, it evicted a node and started returning 503s for decrypts. Repro: looped 200 concurrent decrypts for 3m from test-runner vm.

sanjay: ugh. did the proxy crash or was it eviction from k8s?

jessie: no crash. k8s evicted pod with reason: 'ExceededNodeAllocatable' then HPA spun up 2 more but they failed to join kv cache. logs: 

jessie: ```
2026-03-20T12:01:02Z keystore-proxy[main] WARN connection limit reached for 10.1.3.5
2026-03-20T12:01:05Z keystore-proxy[main] ERROR failed to refresh rbac token: 401 unauthorized
2026-03-20T12:01:07Z keystore-proxy[main] INFO evicting cache shard id=3
```

morgan: did we hit RBAC token TTL / KMS auth rotate? sounds like token refresh race where SA creds were being rotated while many requests came through.

ops_aaron: check audit logs on KMS side and the token issuer. run:

ops_aaron: ```bash
kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kube/priv-kc logs -n priv-keystore -l app=keystore-proxy --since=10m
sudo journalctl -u auditd -o short --since '10 minutes ago' | grep keystore
# cloud kms check example (depends on provider)
aws kms list-keys --region eu-west-1 || gcloud kms keys list --location global
```

jessie: pinned outputs: got multiple 401s around 12:01, and an RBAC reconcile job ran at 12:00:58 which rotated the SA token because of an earlier test change.

sec-bot: ALERT: possible regression in ephemeral-cred refresh policy on private deploy 'eu-onprem-01' — created ticket INF-5342

sanjay: mitigation options:
- increase connlimit per-source temporarily
- add 5s backoff & jitter on rbac token refresh path
- ensure keystore proxy tolerates transient 401s by retrying with exponential backoff
- add a canary that simulates mass decrypts before rotation

jessie: also audit logging showed missing correlation_id on some decrypt requests — makes triage harder. we should enforce X-Request-Id in proxy and ensure auditd captures it.

morgan: agree. for Private we should also update netpols to rate-limit egress from test-runner namespace so perf tests can't take down keystore.

ops_aaron: created short runbook in runbooks/onprem-keystore-eviction.md and pushed to repo. immediate fix: roll back RBAC reconcile job to last known-good, restart keystore-proxy pods to clear stuck cache.

jessie: did rollback, restarted pods, decrypts recovered ~60s after restart. we also preserved /var/log/keystore and uploaded to forensics bucket.

sanjay: follow-ups:
- add at-least-once retry and 401 handling
- add auditd fields for request_id + svcacc
- harden KMS integration: require HSM session reuse metrics, fail closed if more than X 401/s
- update private deploy playbook with eviction checklist

morgan: can someone take INF-5342? assigning to @jessie

jessie: taking it. I'll draft PR for retry + backoff and netpol guard.

sec-bot: reminder: schedule purple-team run to simulate this on staging with netpol and RBAC rotations

jessie: ack :thumbsup:
